sourceTitle: A Manual of Elementary Geology or, The Ancient Changes of the Earth and its Inhabitants as Illustrated by Geological Monuments
description: "A Manual of Elementary Geology" by Sir Charles Lyell is a scientific publication written in the mid-19th century. This work serves as a foundational guide for understanding geology, focusing on the ancient changes of the Earth and its inhabitants as illustrated by geological monuments.
